subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about winning paid subscriptions from the UK funnel. Since Spotify raised UK Premium again in January 2026, from GBP 11.99 to GBP 12.99, the paywall is higher and every free listener weighs the upgrade harder. Subscription CPAs across EMEA run roughly GBP 2 to GBP 4, the band where confirmed-billing screening and incrementality decide your real cost per paying subscriber. We hold paid conversions against a holdout, so the subscribers we add sit on top of those who would upgrade anyway. Worth comparing against your source mix?
angle: fresh angle: timely Spotify Jan 2026 UK price hike (sourced) + EMEA subscription CPA band
register_notes: Stage 2 EN subscription_media UK: acknowledges second follow-up and references prior email; fresh angle = timely development (Spotify UK Premium price increase to GBP 12.99, Jan 2026, Music Business Worldwide) plus market CPA band (EMEA subscription CPA GBP 2 to GBP 4, Business of Apps); peer named only from candidates (Spotify); MobUpps holdout/incrementality referenced with no figure; exactly 1 question mark; market-context numbers real and web-verified with URLs in enrichment_sources; no sign-off; native UK English; no 'X, not Y'; no em dash.
